claims: The 2026 Spring (Vernal) Equinox occurs on March 20.
The 2026 Spring (Vernal) Equinox marks the astronomical start of spring in the Northern Hemisphere.
At the 2026 Spring (Vernal) Equinox, the Sun passes directly over the Earth's equator.
At the 2026 Spring (Vernal) Equinox, daylight and night are nearly equal in length globally.
The 2026 Spring Equinox falls on March 20.
The Spring Equinox can occur on March 19, 20, or 21 depending on the year.
At the Spring Equinox, the Earth's rotation axis is perpendicular to the Sun-Earth line.
At the Spring Equinox, neither hemisphere tilts toward or away from the Sun.
At the Spring Equinox, the Sun is directly over the equator at midday.
At the Spring Equinox, the Sun is moving northward.
The phrase "equal night" implies 12 hours of day and 12 hours of night.
Farmers' Almanac says daytime is slightly longer due to atmospheric refraction.
After the Spring Equinox date, the Northern Hemisphere tilts toward the Sun.
In the Southern Hemisphere, the 2026 Spring (Vernal) Equinox marks the start of the Autumn Equinox.
The equinox is traditionally celebrated with festivals such as the pagan holiday of Ostara, described in Mental Floss.
The equinox often aligns with new year celebrations such as the Persian New Year (Nowruz).
History.com reports that the equinox dictates the timing of holidays like Easter.
